clips.send: A middle-aged professional sends this to a parent dreading retirement: awe that purpose, not age, decides when you are done.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he met a 92-year-old at a spa - sharp enough to still go on the hikes, just not the big mountain one anymore. At dinner, the man told him he was not retired: he still works part time as a lawyer, a few days a week, half days, inside the Empire State Building.

His reason: "I like to do it." Not obligation. Not money he needed. Just somewhere he still wanted to be.

Comment "BRAIN" and I will send you the free training on why purpose, not your birth year, decides when you are finished.
